text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the shopping district,
I spotted Espoir City.
She seemed to be frantically searching for something—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Aaargh! Why isn't there any info at all?!
This is why I hate old shops...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm hmm. Are ya lookin' for something?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! They said there was a shop sellin' awesome health tea
around here, so I went out of my way to—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Acuteee?!
Wh-What're you doing popping up outta nowhere?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, pardon me.
I just thought I might be able to help.
Let's see, you were talkin' about tea, right...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I didn't ask for your help!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If we're talkin' about tea shops around here...
Maybe "Chacha Garden" or "Deep Green Valley", I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's also the "Treasure Leaf Shop".
If we walk a bit further, there are others—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ............How do you know all this?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know plenty of familiar shops in this shopping district.
There's one right nearby, so I'll show ya the way.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, hey!
I never asked you to guide me?!

text_block_list.name: Well-Informed Granny
text_block_list.text:
If it's that sort of stuff you're after, I heard Old Granny Yaminabe's
place just got some good stock in...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Yama-san's shop on the back alley, right?
Thanks a bunch, thanks a bunch.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...What is up
with this granny network...?!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Granny
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, is this Acu-san's friend?
We've got all sorts of goods, so take your time and have a look-see.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ack?! Is all of this tea?!
How are there this many varieties?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. With this many options,
what Espo-san is looking for is bound to be here.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just gotta search patiently.
I'll start checkin' the shelves on the right.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, found it! This is the tea!
With this, Mom will—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
............Gh, *cough*!
Finally done! Man, what a pain in the neck!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. That turned out well, didn't it, Espo-san?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
............
...Why'd you go this far to help me out?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Oh, stop it.
Helping each other out in times of trouble is just what we do.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If there's something I can do to help,
I'll gladly lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even if it takes a bit of time and effort,
won't both of us feel much better that way?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even without knowin' all the details,
one look at Espo-san's face gave me a pretty good hunch.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...You were looking for a present
for someone precious to you, weren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
............ What is your deal...!
It's always like... you see right through everything...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
Espo-san, you really are such a sweet girl.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haaah?! As if! I'm nothing like that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's generosity and resilience.
It was a moment that offered a glimpse into those qualities.
